turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello Adrian, Melissa Lim here. Thanks for making time for our telephone appointment. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak? I know you usually fit these calls between meetings, so I'll keep us on track.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Melissa. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. Telephone is easier for me than coming down to the branch. I've got a little breathing space before the next meeting, so this timing is good.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good, thanks. Before we get into the discussion, could you provide your identification details for the usual verification process?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll keep the discussion concise, as you requested, and cover the necessary points. [[EV_001]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That suits me. I still follow technology industry developments, mostly through public conference talks and interviews. These days I'm particularly interested in how businesses organise their workflows. There's plenty to read, but not much time to get through it all.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Yes, running the business must keep your diary quite full. We can leave the general catch-up for another occasion and focus on today's discussion. [[EV_002]] [[EV_003]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_008]] I appreciate the direct wording. That's how I prefer these conversations.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll continue in that style, without adding unnecessary technical detail. [[EV_009]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_011]] One administrative question before we finish: will the usual correspondence be available through the secure banking inbox? That's easier for me to keep organised.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Yes, the secure inbox is where you can look for the usual correspondence. If you have any trouble accessing it, contact me through the bank's usual channel and I can help with navigation.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, thanks. For future appointments, let's stick with telephone where possible. My assistant manages the diary, but I prefer to speak with you directly rather than have messages passed back and forth.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. We can use your usual appointment arrangements and keep the conversation directly with you. Thanks for your time today, Adrian. I'll let you get back to your afternoon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Melissa. This format works well for me. Have a good afternoon, bye.
